item: OSM reference run onto the shared passphrase scrub
summary: The runner's texts go through secret_scrub: scrub() calls scrubbed (every shape of the throwaway key plus every passphrase the process holds, a too-short secret withholding the text), its two exception handlers and the command's refusal lines write exception_text (a UnicodeError by class alone), the finished report keeps a paths-only pass, and the module moves from the not-guarded list to the guarded modules of the passphrase-handler walk. Tests: the operator's own held passphrase is taken out of a child's words, the runner-failure and phase-start handlers, the refusal line, a key that is a verdict word; each fails when its scrub is removed.
